definitions.explanation: The act of listing items one by one. Used when presenting a series of examples, reasons, or items in a systematic way.

examples.japanese: {理由|りゆう}を{列挙|れっきょ}する。
{問題点|もんだいてん}を{一|ひと}つずつ{列挙|れっきょ}した。
examples.english: I listed the issues one by one.

examples.japanese: レポートでは{具体的|ぐたいてき}な{事例|じれい}を{列挙|れっきょ}して{論点|ろんてん}を{裏付|うらづ}けた。
examples.english: In the report, specific examples were listed to support the argument.

notes:
{列挙|れっきょ} means listing items systematically, one by one. Composed of {列|れつ} (row/line) + {挙|きょ} (to raise/cite).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理由|りゆう}を{列挙|れっきょ}する: to list reasons
- {条件|じょうけん}を{列挙|れっきょ}する: to enumerate conditions
- {事例|じれい}を{列挙|れっきょ}する: to list examples
- {問題点|もんだいてん}を{列挙|れっきょ}する: to enumerate problems

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {羅列|られつ}: listing without organization (often implies a disorganized list)
- {挙|あ}げる: to cite, to give (examples) — more casual
- リストアップする: to list up (loanword, more casual)

REGISTER:
{列挙|れっきょ} is a formal, written-style word common in academic papers, legal documents, and business reports. In conversation, {挙|あ}げる is more natural.
